verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents trace ingestion through its SDK or an OpenTelemetry exporter. Agent keys carry a traces:write scope, and a per-trial Timeline shows everything one agent did during a trial, so multi-step runs are captured and grouped by trial. However, nested span hierarchies and grouping into sessions or threads are never explicitly documented; OTel support only implies span semantics. Missing for 10: explicit nested parent/child span documentation, session/thread grouping of traces (beyond per-trial Timeline), independent or hands-on corroboration.
